description: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 (1.1-90 kW) over the built-in RS485 port, Modbus RTU with the FC control profile
source: Danfoss, "VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 1.1-90 kW Design Guide", MG11BC22 (06/2014); https://assets.danfoss.com/documents/272740/AJ299549559248en-US1801.pdf

sources.title: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 1.1-90 kW Design Guide
sources.note: chapter 8.6 to 8.11 (Modbus RTU, register map, FC profile)

notes: Holding register of parameter x-yy is 10 times its number: 3-12 is register 3120, 8-30 is register 8300. Array parameters need the index in register 9 first.
Registers and coils are numbered from 1 in the guide, and the bus address is one less (register 50000 is sent as 49999), so this map uses address_base 1.
Control word, bus reference, status word and main actual value sit at registers 50000, 50010, 50200 and 50210.

This map lists the registers the design guide describes and a few parameters it uses as examples. The other parameters, their sizes and conversion indexes are in the FC 102 programming guide; a 32-bit parameter takes two registers.
The guide also describes the control word and status word as coils (1 to 16 and 33 to 48); they are not in this map, use the registers instead.
To enable Modbus: 8-30 Protocol = Modbus RTU, 8-31 Address 1 to 247, 8-32 Baud rate 2400 to 115200, 8-33 even parity with 1 stop bit by default.
Function codes: 1, 3, 5, 6, 15 and 16, plus 11, 17 and the diagnostics function 8.

registers.name: Last error code
registers.description: Last error code from an FC data object interface

registers.name: Parameter index
registers.description: Index used for the next access to an array parameter; set it before reading or writing one

registers.name: Control word
registers.description: FC profile control word (8-10 Control Profile = FC profile)

registers.name: Control word - Preset reference select
registers.description: Chooses one of the four values of 3-10 Preset Reference (bits 0 and 1)

registers.name: Control word - DC brake
registers.description: 0 = DC brake and stop, 1 = ramp

registers.name: Control word - Coasting
registers.description: 0 = coast to a stop, 1 = no coasting

registers.name: Control word - Quick stop
registers.description: 0 = quick stop, 1 = ramp

registers.name: Control word - Hold output frequency
registers.description: 0 = hold the present output frequency, 1 = use the ramp

registers.name: Control word - Start
registers.description: 0 = ramp stop, 1 = start

registers.name: Control word - Reset
registers.description: Reset a trip on the rising edge

registers.name: Control word - Jog
registers.description: 1 = run at the jog speed (3-19)

registers.name: Control word - Ramp 2
registers.description: 0 = ramp 1, 1 = ramp 2

registers.name: Control word - Data valid
registers.description: 1 = the drive uses the control word, 0 = it ignores it

registers.name: Control word - Relay 01
registers.description: 1 = relay 01 on, if 5-40 Function Relay selects control word bit 11

registers.name: Control word - Relay 02
registers.description: 1 = relay on, if 5-40 Function Relay selects control word bit 12. The text calls it relay 04 and the table relay 02

registers.name: Control word - Set-up select
registers.description: Needs Multi Set-ups (bits 13 and 14)

registers.name: Control word - Reverse
registers.description: 1 = reverse

registers.name: Bus reference
registers.description: Speed reference as a share of the maximum reference: 16384 (4000 hex) is 100 %, negative is reverse (two's complement)

registers.name: Status word
registers.description: FC profile status word

registers.name: Status word - Enabled (not coasting)
registers.description: 0 = coasting, 1 = enabled

registers.name: Status word - Trip
registers.description: 1 = tripped; reset to resume

registers.name: Status word - Speed equals reference
registers.description: 1 = motor speed matches the reference

registers.name: Status word - Bus control
registers.description: 1 = the drive can be controlled over the serial line, 0 = local operation

registers.name: Status word - Frequency limit OK
registers.description: 0 = output frequency at the low or high speed limit

registers.name: Status word - Stopped, auto-start
registers.description: 1 = stopped for inverter over-temperature and resumes by itself

registers.name: Main actual value
registers.description: Actual output frequency in the same scale as the bus reference: 16384 (4000 hex) is 100 %

registers.name: 3-12 Catch up/slow-down value
registers.description: Parameter 3-12; the manual's example: 1352 is 12.52 %

registers.name: 4-14 Motor speed high limit [Hz]
registers.description: Parameter 4-14; the manual's write example sends 1000 for 100 Hz

registers.name: 8-30 Protocol
registers.description: Set to Modbus RTU to use this map

registers.name: 8-32 Baud rate
registers.description: 2400 to 115200 baud, coded as in the programming guide

registers.name: 8-33 Parity / stop bits
registers.description: Default: even parity, 1 stop bit; coded as in the programming guide

registers.name: Parameter write control
registers.description: 0 = parameter changes go to RAM only, 1 = to RAM and EEPROM
